resources.string: Optional local learning from explicit choices only. Up to 512 distinct records are kept outside backups. Disabling collection stops new examples; Reset removes saved examples and patterns. A fixed fifth of expected words is reserved for testing and never trains patterns. New patterns remain inactive until they improve that holdout without a single regression; the previous active policy is retained and restored if later canary evidence is worse. With example collection and typo learning enabled, this check runs locally from 01:00–05:00 only while charging, idle, thermally safe, and not low on battery or storage. Results compare local suggestions on normalized words, excluding model, touch and exact-pair personalization; this is not automatic editing accuracy. Small or empty samples do not establish accuracy.
